safety_policy: Dry-run and compare/extract planning only. Do not execute upstream analysis code, download large archives, or copy external implementations into production modules.

bids_root.label: ds003059 BIDS root
bids_root.purpose: Raw or BIDS-compatible ds003059 tree for reconstruction paths.

derivatives_root.label: Cached ds003059 derivatives
derivatives_root.purpose: Local rest-run summaries, targets, and module time series used as the first comparison substrate.

parcellations_root.label: Cached parcellations
parcellations_root.purpose: Generated atlas/parcellation outputs for methods that need ROI definitions or FC matrices.

receptor_maps_root.label: Receptor/map priors
receptor_maps_root.purpose: Public receptor, cortical-map, and spatial-null artifacts used as prior layers, not biological proof.

structural_connectome_root.label: Structural connectome
structural_connectome_root.purpose: HCP-derived or proxy structural graph artifacts for network-control comparisons.

families.label: CopBET entropy
families.comparison_target: Compare entropy and complexity summaries against Stage 2 LSD-placebo target deltas and current macro-dynamics metrics.
families.claim_boundary: Toolbox reproduction context only; entropy metrics do not become original thesis evidence until independently run and documented.

families.label: Cortical gradients / BrainSpace
families.comparison_target: Compare gradient shifts or aligned embeddings against local map-prior sensitivity and dynamic hierarchy evidence.
families.claim_boundary: Gradient tooling informs sensitivity checks; it is not completed external validation by itself.

families.label: Neuroreceptor priors / eigenmodes
families.comparison_target: Compare receptor-prior components against A+B+C+D+E mechanism layers without promoting receptor-level realism.
families.claim_boundary: Receptor maps are priors and require null controls before any claim promotion.

families.label: Ising thermodynamics and LZW complexity
families.comparison_target: Compare temperature/complexity directionality against surrogate temperature, barrier, and repertoire proxies.
families.claim_boundary: Use as benchmark inspiration unless the local derivatives and independent implementation are verified.

families.label: LSD and music brain states
families.comparison_target: Compare occupancy, transition, and dwell summaries against dynamic repertoire and hierarchy-routing layers.
families.claim_boundary: Run-02/music claims remain blocked until local exclusion, motion, and context controls pass.

families.label: Energy landscape / network control
families.comparison_target: Compare state transition-energy summaries against local transition-barrier and control-energy proxies.
families.claim_boundary: Network-control language stays model-level unless structural and receptor provenance is explicit.

families.label: REACT receptor connectivity
families.comparison_target: Compare receptor-enriched connectivity outputs against receptor-prior sensitivity gates.
families.claim_boundary: General toolbox context; not ds003059-specific biological validation without local aligned inputs.

families.label: Dynamic integration / segregation
families.comparison_target: Compare integration/segregation state summaries against current macro-dynamics surrogate evidence.
families.claim_boundary: Public method code supports proxy comparison only; MATLAB upstream execution is not assumed.

families.label: GNW/IIT consciousness archive
families.comparison_target: Compare anterior/posterior FC and integration summaries as context only, not as a consciousness-theory adjudication.
families.claim_boundary: Context archive only; this repository does not settle GNW/IIT or cross-state consciousness claims.

families.label: Traveling waves
families.comparison_target: Compare wave-propagation summaries only after a dedicated local CPC implementation exists.
families.claim_boundary: Supporting dependency only until a dedicated analysis implementation is verified.

families.label: Mesoscale ReHo
families.comparison_target: Compare local synchrony summaries against surrogate regional-stability proxies after independent reconstruction.
families.claim_boundary: No verified public code; reconstruction stays future work unless scripts are found or authored independently.

families.label: DLPFC Granger causality
families.comparison_target: Compare directional-flow summaries only after code or a defensible independent reconstruction is available.
families.claim_boundary: Author-only code; manual contact or independent reconstruction required before testing.

families.label: Translational neuromodeling teaching resource
families.comparison_target: Use as setup and DCM workflow reference, not as a primary ds003059 prior-art claim.
families.claim_boundary: Secondary/pedagogical source; do not treat as a primary reproducibility target.
